note: The field journal (docs 13, 15): the words it writes and the numbers that shape them. order: the living things with pages, in page order. Each species: name and icon (src/ui/icons), riddle (shown before it has been seen), amount ([at least this many plants, words] steps; grass uses share of the dry ground instead), place and compass (where words: compass false skips the side of the island), none (after it has gone), clause words (flowering, dormant, spreading, receding), stages (what tapping one says, by growth stage: seed, sprout, young, mature, flowering, dormant), seasons (what each season box says: grow per season, flower, dormant), likes (lines learned when one of the learn triggers happens: seen, spread, flower, lost:drown, lost:seed, refused:<need>, grass:flooded), gives (a pencil line until the when trigger, then the ink line), notes (the lines the journal writes). trend: a species is spreading when it has gained at least max(upMin, upShare x then) plants over trend hours, receding when it has lost at least max(downMin, downShare x then). where: spreadOut is the mean distance from the plants' middle, as a share of the island's radius, past which they are all around the island; centerShare is how close to the island's middle counts as the middle. notesKept: notes the journal keeps; pageNotes: notes on a species page. islandNote: how long a note stays on the island (showS), the gap between two (gapS) and how many may wait (queue). identify: how near a tap must be to a plant (radiusM), how long the card stays (showS), and the size of the breathing ring around what was tapped (ringM for a full-grown plant, smaller for young ones; grassRingM on grass; its timing is in recipes/world/growth.json marks). arrivedHours: plants seen within this many hours of the journal starting were here when you arrived.
